call_summary.status: Third-party transcription of management call; no raw transcript in public-safe files; primary release controls numeric conflicts.
call_summary.paraphrase: Management described advanced packaging near one-quarter of product sales, product mix roughly 73% logic/foundry and 27% memory/other, stronger GAA demand and expanding US manufacturing capacity. It planned a refreshed strategy presentation in Q1 2027. These are attributed operating comments rather than audited segment results. Packaging overlaps logic/memory; the percentages must not be added.

cost_of_capital.judgments: 3% target straight-debt weight, 150bp debt spread and mature beta 1.10 are analyst assumptions, not observed issuer debt quotes. Zero coupon is not zero debt cost. USD market inputs dated October 2026 apply to a December 2025 capital and discount origin, making this a retrospective-information analytical case, not a point-in-time backtest. No arbitrary additive Israel premium: specific concentration, conflict and export risks are modeled in operations; independent audit should stress additional country risk.

compensation.policy: Economic margins retain 4.0% revenue fresh-grant cost initially, fading to 3.5%, versus 3.83% FY2025 grant value and 2.99% amortized expense. Legacy amortization is displayed and identically reversed before economic NOPAT. Existing RSUs are charged once as gross units; existing options are a separate fair-value claim parameter. No future dilution or buyback benefit after charging future grant cost. No additional old-award tax shield credited. Performance payout and option time value remain gates.

capped_call.warning: Historical premium is not December fair value. Form settlement and averaging differ from a simple point-in-time payoff. Corporate-action changes and counterparties matter.
capped_call.contract_evidence: Filed form defaults to cash settlement, allows net-share or combination election subject to Israeli distribution restrictions, uses 40 valid-day averaging before maturity, and excludes discretionary and make-whole conversion adjustments. Form contains blanks; aggregate strike, cap, shares and premium are sourced to annual note and issuance disclosure. No exact December fair value disclosed.

capital_bridge.convertible_policy: Full December Level2 quoted claim includes the conversion option. Do not deduct principal again or add 2.34255m underlying shares to the denominator. Unlike ONTO, Nova can elect cash, ordinary shares or both for the full conversion value; there is no asserted mandatory cash principal settlement. Fundamental-change cash redemption applies. Fixed observed claim across intrinsic scenarios is conditional, not internally repriced issuer valuation. 2025 notes were fully converted by year-end; 2.432803m converted shares already in common count.
capital_bridge.lease_policy: 67.475m operating lease liability excluded from financial debt because rent remains in operating margin. No ROU asset or rent addback. FY2025 lease cash8.254 versus expense7.949; normalized rent embedded in margins.
capital_bridge.tax_policy: Entire39.148m governmental-institution liability is conservatively treated as an opening claim because the tax/VAT split is unavailable. Excluded from modeled operating NWC to avoid double charge. Gross UTB10.760 includes4.036 DTA offset; only6.724 treated as separate claim. Net DTA28.598 not added at book: recurring benefit represented by cash-tax fade16.5% to23%; no extra NOL or award shield asset. Residual opening tax, repatriation, derivative and other claims remain gated.
capital_bridge.capital_payables_policy: FY2025 cash capex27.698 plus closing unpaid1.617 minus opening7.248 gives22.067 accrual additions before acquisition/FX. Opening1.617 is deducted once as a separate claim and removed from supplier financing in operating capital. Forecast capex is cash funded with no new capital-payable financing. Inventory purchase commitments152.965 support inventory funding; they are not deducted again as debt.
capital_bridge.bank_deposit_policy: Noncurrent12.508 excluded pending full restriction/liquidity mapping; .318 is identified lease collateral, remaining12.190 is not silently declared free. Excluded assets can be sensitized separately.
capital_bridge.later_events: June2026 liquid balances and current-debt classification are evidence only, not spliced into this December bridge. September200m buyback is authorization, not known spending; no fictional share reduction.

assumptions.thesis: Near-term Q3 midpoint holds, Q4 falls to 270m; AI/customer spending slips in 2027 and inventory stays funded. Gradual recovery cannot restore peak margins.

H1 actual490.266 plus Q3 midpoint282 plus analyst Q4300. GAA/materials/chemical and packaging adoption produce 17.5% growth in 2027 then decelerate. Financial target margins are adjusted for full economic fresh grants.
Q4330 and broad adoption sustain 25% growth in 2027, with packaging and service attach improving mix. Growth still consumes working capital and manufacturing capacity.

risks: AI/GAA/HBM capacity spending can reverse; service upgrades are partly cyclical, not fixed recurring subscriptions.
China33%, Taiwan29%, Korea16% and largest customer23% of FY2025 revenue create export, geopolitical and buying-power exposure. Israeli operations face conflict and workforce disruption risks.
Materials and chemical metrology competition and design wins must translate into durable process steps; technology differentiation does not guarantee pricing.
Sentronics acquisition adds scale and integration risk; 2025 growth is not fully organic. R&D remains expensed and funded.
H126 CFO80.995 is well below net income144.269 as receivables and deferred revenue consume cash; profit growth is not immediately distributable cash.
Cash growth is partly convert financing. Convertible value exceeds face; capped calls have limited payoff and counterparty risk. September buyback authority is not actual capital return.
Tax incentives and annual compensation costs can fade adversely; terminal margins and returns are scenario assumptions, not observed guarantees.

operating_capital_diagnostic.policy: Excludes government/tax claims assigned separately, noncurrent operating items, lease ROU/liabilities net and any R&D asset. Historical high book returns reflect expensed R&D and mature products, not a warrant for infinite economic returns. Early marginal sales/capital1.6–2.0 is conservative versus recent narrow closing2.9; terminal ROIC13–22% materially fades returns and pays for g.
